content.hebrew: אֱ֒מֶת הָאֵל : לְיִשְׂרָאֵל : יְצַוֶּה נָא : סְלִיחוֹתָיו :
content.transliteration: Emet ha’el : leyisra’el : yetsavvē na : seliḥotav:
content.english: God is true to Israel; may he now order their forgiveness,

content.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר פָּשַׁע : בְּכָל רֶשַׁע : לְמוּל פָּנָיו : בְּמִצְוֹתָיו:
content.transliteration: Asher pasha‘ : bechol resha‘ : lemul panav : bemitsvotav:
content.english: For they have sinned with all types of evil, in his presence, against his commandments.

content.hebrew: וְיִמְחוֹל לוֹ : בְּמִפְעָלוֹ : כְּלַל מִרְיוֹ : וְחַטֹּאתָיו :
content.transliteration: Veyimḥol lo : bemif‘alo : kelal miryo : veḥattotav:
content.english: May he pardon them for their actions, their general rebellion, and their sins.

content.hebrew: לְהוֹפִיעוֹ : לְהוֹשִׁיעוֹ : לְרַחֵם לוֹ : בְּמִדּוֹתָיו :
content.english: May he shine for them, rescue them, and show compassion for them, in accordance with his qualities.

content.hebrew: וְהוּא יִפְדֶּה אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל מִכֹּל עֲוֹנוֹתָיו :
content.english: And may he redeem Israel from all their iniquities.

content.hebrew: וְהוּא יִפְדֶּה אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל מִכֹּל עֲוֹנוֹתָיו :
content.english: And may he redeem Israel from all their iniquities.

content.hebrew: בְּ֒יוֹם שׁוּבוֹ : בְּכָל לִבּוֹ : זְמָן עָשׂוֹר : תְּשׁוּבָתוֹ :
content.transliteration: Beyom shuvo : bechol libbo : zeman ‘asor : teshuvato:
content.english: On the day that they repent whole-heartedly, the Tenth [of Tishri], the time of their repentance,

content.hebrew: לְהִתְוַדּוֹת : וְגַם הוֹדוֹת : לְאֵל רַחוּם : יְשׁוּעָתוֹ :
content.transliteration: Lehitvaddot : veḡam hodot : le’el raḥum : yeshu‘ato:
content.english: To confess, and acknowledge the compassionate God’s act of rescue,

content.hebrew: וְאָז יוֹאֵל : רְצוֹן שֹׁאֵל : לְקַבֵּל אֶת : שְׁאֵלָתוֹ :
content.transliteration: Ve’az yo’el : retson sho’el : leḳabbel et : she’elato:
content.english: He will then agree to the petitioners’ desire, to accept their petition,

content.hebrew: כְּרֹב חַסְדּוֹ : וְרֹב הוֹדוֹ : יְכַפֵּר נָא : בְּשִׁגְגָתוֹ :
content.transliteration: Kerov ḥasdo : verov hodo : yechapper na : beshiḡeḡato:
content.english: In accordance with his great kindness and his great splendor, he will now atone their mistakes,

content.hebrew: מְנַת חֶבְלוֹ : וְגוֹרָלוֹ : אֲשֶׁר פַּסּוּ : עֲתִירוֹתָיו :
content.english: For [Israel], his designated portion, his lot, whose prayers will have concluded,

content.hebrew: וְהוּא יִפְדֶּה אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל מִכֹּל עֲוֹנוֹתָיו :
content.english: And may he redeem Israel from all their iniquities.

content.hebrew: רְ֒צוֹת עֶלְיוֹן : לְעַם צִיּוֹן : חֲזוֹת בִּנְיָן : וְנוֹעֲמוֹ :
content.transliteration: Retsot ‘elyon : le‘am tsiyyon : ḥazot binyan : veno‘amo:
content.english: May the One on High show favor to the people of Zion, to let them see it built up, and his sweetness,

content.hebrew: מְעוֹן שִׁבְתּוֹ : מְכוֹנָתוֹ : וְהַהֵיכָל : וְאוּלָמוֹ :
content.english: The residence of his presence, his dwelling, and the sanctuary and its hall,

content.hebrew: מְקוֹם קָדְשׁוֹ : וּמִקְדָּשׁוֹ : וְהַהַרְאֵל : בְּקִיּוּמוֹ :
content.english: His holy place, his Temple, and the altar, all standing,

content.hebrew: וְהַמִּשְׁכָּן : אֲשֶׁר שָׁכַן : בְּמִשְׁכֶּנֶת : שְׁמֵי רוּמוֹ :
content.transliteration: Vehammishkan : asher shachan : bemishkenet : shemē rumo:
content.english: And the Tabernacle, where he dwelled in a dwelling [like] that in his heavens,

content.hebrew: יְקִימֵהוּ : יְכוֹנְנֵהוּ : בְּמַתְכּוּנְתּוֹ : וּמַעְלוֹתָיו :
content.english: May he stand it up, may he set it up, in accordance with its measurements and its qualities.

content.hebrew: וְהוּא יִפְדֶּה אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל מִכֹּל עֲוֹנוֹתָיו :
content.english: And may he redeem Israel from all their iniquities.

content.hebrew: הֲ֒לֹא יָדְעוּ : וְאַף שָׁמְעוּ : בְּנֵי אֵל חַי אֲדֹנֵינוּ :
content.transliteration: Halo yade‘u : ve’af shame‘u : benē el ḥai : adonenu:
content.english: The children of the living God, our lord, surely know, and have heard,

content.hebrew: וְהִסְכִּימוּ : וְהֵקִימוּ : בְּיַד נָבִיא : וְחוֹזֵינוּ :
content.english: And have agreed, and established, by the hand of our prophets and seers,

content.hebrew: עֲשׂוֹת צֶדֶק : וְהַבֶּדֶק : וּמִשְׁפַּט צוּר : אֱלֹהֵינוּ :
content.english: To do acts of justice, and fix [their ways], and the laws of the Rock, our God,

content.hebrew: וְהַצְנֵעַ : בְּהַכְנֵעַ : בְּעֵת לֶכֶת : לְקָדְשֵׁנוּ :
content.english: And to be meek and humble, when they are walking to our holy place.

content.hebrew: בְּזֹאת חָפֵץ : בְּכָל חֵפֶץ : וְלֹא שֶׁלֶם : מְרִיאֵנוּ :
content.transliteration: Bezot ḥafets : bechol ḥefets : velo shelem : meri’enu:
content.english: This is what [God] wants, with full desire – not shelamim-offerings of fatlings.

content.hebrew: וְלֵב נִשְׁבָּר : וְגַם נָבָר : יְקַבֵּל שֵׁם : קְרִיאוֹתָיו :
content.transliteration: Velev nishbar : veḡam navar : yeḳabbel shem : ḳeri’otav:
content.english: Broken hearts, pure hearts – the Name [God] will accept their cries.

content.hebrew: וְהוּא יִפְדֶּה אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל מִכֹּל עֲוֹנוֹתָיו :
content.english: And may he redeem Israel from all their iniquities.

content.hebrew: מְ֒קוֹם זֶבַח : נְתוֹן שֶׁבַח : וְהוֹדָיָה : לְאֵל נוֹרָא :
content.transliteration: Meḳom zevaḥ : neton shevaḥ : vehodaya : le’el nora:
content.english: In place of sacrifice, give praise and thanks to the awesome God,

content.hebrew: וְהַקְשִׁיבָה : בְּדֵי אַהֲבָה : בְּכָל נֶפֶשׁ : מְטֹהָרָה :
content.transliteration: Vehaḳshiva : bedē ahava : bechol nefesh : metohara:
content.english: And to heed [God’s laws], with a great amount of love, with a whole, pure, soul.

content.hebrew: בְּלֹא רֵיחַ : וְנִיחֹחַ : וְלֹא עוֹלָה : וְאֶשְׁכָּרָה :
content.english: When sweet savors are absent, and there are no burnt offering or such gifts,

content.hebrew: וְיָעִירוּ : וְיָשִׁירוּ : לְלוֹ הַהוֹד : וְהַהֶדְרָה :
content.english: People must rouse themselves and sing to the One who has splendor and beauty,

content.hebrew: לְהַגְדִּילָם : לְהַנְחִילָם : נְעִימוֹתָיו : וְטוֹבוֹתָיו :
content.english: So that he will give them greatness, and bequeath them his sweetness and goodnesss.

content.hebrew: וְהוּא יִפְדֶּה אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל מִכֹּל עֲוֹנוֹתָיו :
content.english: And may he redeem Israel from all their iniquities.
